---
title: "💬 Feedback"
subtitle: "Help improve the EVD Toolkit experience"

We value your input to improve this tool and enhance patient safety.

## Why Your Feedback Matters

- Improve usability and workflow
- Identify gaps in clinical guidance
- Enhance safety and decision support
- Support future research and QI initiatives

## Share Your Feedback

This survey is administered through REDCap (Research Electronic Data Capture), a secure platform used for research data collection at the University of Washington.

```{=html}
<a href="https://redcap.link/evdtoolkit" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="fs-card" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;padding:18px 20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ios-blue), var(--ios-indigo));border-radius:14px;color:white;">
```

## Confidentiality

Feedback is collected anonymously unless you choose to provide identifying information.

::: {.callout-note}
This survey is being conducted as part of a research study evaluating clinical implementation of the EVD Toolkit, reviewed by the University of Washington Human Subjects Division and determined exempt from further IRB review (STUDY00026573, approved 9/16/2026). Participation is voluntary.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Your insights directly contribute to improving EVD safety and education.
:::
